calls.reason: The September 2023 survey lists many alignment approaches besides Constitutional AI, such as debate, task decomposition and interpretability. But 'few' and 'on the table' have no standard to count against, so the claim can't fairly be called.

AHA! and SafetyBench only cover adjacent abilities: listing possible harms and answering multiple-choice safety questions. Neither tests whether models reliably foresee what their own recommendations lead to, so the evidence is too thin to call.

An October 2023 study found that defenses meant to prevent prompt injection had limited effect. A plugin study found OpenAI's safeguards insufficient and not fully enforced. Some controls existed, but both point to weak controls over connected AI.
